entries.oldClaim: You must make 20 successful API calls in the demo environment before Go-Live.
entries.currentFact: DocuSign eliminated the 20-API-call requirement in its streamlined Go-Live experience. Older threads and integrator docs still cite it.

entries.oldClaim: A Marketplace listing needs 5 active workspace installs.
entries.currentFact: The requirement is 10 active-workspace installs since July 2026, and it must be maintained during review.

Superseded per Xero's own 2026 pages, which describe connection tiers from 2 Mar 2026 (Starter 5, Core 50, Plus 1,000, Advanced 10,000, Enterprise). Third-party docs still say 25. We did not find an official statement retiring the 25 figure, so the sources conflict.
Google's verification page says 10 business days, and Clearance uses 10. The page giving 3-5 was not captured, so the two Google sources conflict.

entries.oldClaim: Non-Marketplace commercial apps get normal conversations.history rate limits.
entries.currentFact: Since May 29 2025, non-Marketplace commercial apps are limited to 1 request per minute on conversations.history and conversations.replies, with a maximum page size of 15. Whether already-installed apps are affected is conflicting.

unverified: DocuSign's Go-Live page body (rendered by JavaScript, not captured)
Gusto approval durations: the security review is about 1 week per Merge and 2-4 weeks per Finch; Gusto publishes no figure
Developer-setup steps for Google, Slack and DocuSign come from prior knowledge, not captured pages
